repositoryAudit.evidence: Independent private repository created from the documented Premium baseline at a1f1d96.

rootCauseDiagnosis.evidence: Technical-design review identified the desktop-to-service boundary and unsafe-storage gaps.

implementation.evidence: Loopback service now includes durable local volume registration and bounded read-only inspection; scanning and catalogue writes remain disabled.

dependencyConfiguration.evidence: Rust service dependency versions were pinned for the available compiler and compiled successfully.

staticReview.evidence: Rust formatting, service tests, TypeScript strict type checks, and the desktop build pass; Windows service review remains pending.

cleanBuild.evidence: Frontend production build and alpha.2 service crate compile pass; Windows installer and service packaging remain pending.

automatedTests.evidence: Service suite passes 10 safety, persistence, and route tests; inherited desktop suite passes 25 tests, but release validation remains pending.

runtimeUi.evidence: This milestone adds no UI change; service API is validated in-process and desktop wiring is deferred.

persistenceMigration.evidence: A versioned local volume registry persists only approved source metadata with a backup; catalogue migration remains intentionally out of scope.

networkApi.evidence: Loopback health, volume registration, bounded inspection, and dry-run reconciliation routes are tested; write-capable reconciliation returns HTTP 409.

securityPrivacy.evidence: The service defaults to loopback, stores no credentials, accepts only registered volume identifiers for inspection, and rejects write-capable reconciliation.

performanceReliability.evidence: Inspection is limited to 100 immediate entries with no recursion; performance targets and network-volume reliability require later implementation.

crossPlatformParity.evidence: CinaVault 3.0 is establishing a Windows service foundation; Android and iOS changes are outside this milestone.

packaging.evidence: Desktop MSI and NSIS configuration are retained, while server WiX packaging is a later approved milestone.

installationLaunch.evidence: No production Windows Service installer is claimed in the foundation milestone; validation requires a Windows runner.

finalRegression.evidence: Alpha.2 service and inherited frontend tests pass; release authorization remains intentionally false pending Windows service and installer validation.

liveMetadataPull.evidence: Metadata-provider changes are outside the standalone service and volume-foundation milestone.

metadataDatabaseWrite.evidence: Foundation reconciliation is dry-run only and intentionally does not write catalogue or metadata records.

posterInformation.evidence: Artwork migration and managed-poster implementation are deferred until after safe storage foundations.

posterBytes.evidence: Artwork byte delivery is unchanged in this milestone and is not a service-foundation acceptance target.

secureArtworkDelivery.evidence: Managed artwork storage and authenticated delivery are deferred to the later artwork and privacy release.

correctLibraryCard.evidence: No desktop library-card interface change is included in the initial service foundation.

uncappedLibraryTotal.evidence: Large-library performance and durable catalogue scaling require the planned volume and persistence implementation.

providerPersistence.evidence: Provider persistence is deferred while the service remains intentionally local and no-write.

windowsInstallers.evidence: Existing desktop bundle targets are retained; dedicated service installer validation requires the later WiX package and Windows runner.

externalBlockers.reason: The current sandbox validates source, contracts, and loopback behavior but cannot run SCM, WiX, Defender, or firewall integration tests.
externalBlockers.requiredResolution: Run the dedicated Windows installer and service acceptance suite on a signed Windows build runner.
